{"verdicts":[{"id":"e01","verdict":"reject","leaf":"scene_observer","reason":"The report prints a stored expected value instead of reading the game and misses a changed health value. Both are listed false passes for the observer."},{"id":"e02","verdict":"reject","leaf":"mineral_forest","reason":"The sky is required to have lightning without rain. A dry storm that rains is the leaf's red condition."},{"id":"e03","verdict":"accept","leaf":"mineral_forest","reason":"The untouched site at play zoom shows mineral flora and fauna, two distinguishable soils, a rainless lightning sky and five distinct weather states."},{"id":"e04","verdict":"reject","leaf":"pool_chemistry","reason":"Hazardous pool liquid becomes fresh water at the pump boundary. This is an explicit false pass and the red condition."},{"id":"e05","verdict":"reject","leaf":"falter_warning","reason":"The cue starts after harmful exposure. This is the red condition."},{"id":"e06","verdict":"accept","leaf":"falter_warning","reason":"Visible vent and idle-native cues appear about one in-game hour before bloom, without the optional message. Only eligible idle natives hold still, and the worker reaches shelter before the dose."},{"id":"e07","verdict":"reject","leaf":"ambient_protection","reason":"A fully sealed worker takes an ambient metal dose while the gear keeps its hit points. Wearer protection must not be inferred from item survival."},{"id":"e08","verdict":"accept","leaf":"ambient_protection","reason":"The exposed control is harmed, roofed and fully sealed workers keep their starting health, and partial equipment follows its rule."},{"id":"e09","verdict":"reject","leaf":"persistent_metal","reason":"Metal clears on its own under ordinary care. A slow natural decay labelled permanent is a listed false pass."},{"id":"e10","verdict":"accept","leaf":"persistent_metal","reason":"A low saved trace is purged through the normal health bill, with an attributable operation and ingredient consumption."},{"id":"e11","verdict":"reject","leaf":"permanent_acid","reason":"The acid sensory injury heals away and Sight returns to baseline. The leaf's red condition covers effects that heal away and restored capacity."},{"id":"e12","verdict":"reject","leaf":"thornwood_work","reason":"A completed harvest pays no metal, and the rich assay does not follow the payout."},{"id":"e13","verdict":"accept","leaf":"rhossak_renewal","reason":"Three seed-bearing bound sleepers root a young thornwood. The galled animal binds and drops edible galls while remaining seedless."},{"id":"e14","verdict":"reject","leaf":"wildlife_livelihood","reason":"A ranged hit should start a toxic detonation. A shot suush that simply dies is the red condition."},{"id":"e15","verdict":"reject","leaf":"vent_competition","reason":"Lined taps must resist prying. A lined tap taking pry damage is the red condition."},{"id":"e16","verdict":"accept","leaf":"vent_competition","reason":"Wild drinking suppresses output and it recovers afterward. Tame shearing supplies vexxith without killing the animal."},{"id":"e17","verdict":"reject","leaf":"connected_gas","reason":"Sealed diagonal barriers must stop the chain. Leaking through a sealed corner is the red condition."},{"id":"e18","verdict":"reject","leaf":"explosive_displacement","reason":"A dramatic blast throws none of the identified goods. This is the red condition and a listed false pass."},{"id":"e19","verdict":"reject","leaf":"filter_industry","reason":"Work must pause without losing stock. 200 L of input vanishes with no product."},{"id":"e20","verdict":"reject","leaf":"settings_control","reason":"All-off must not cure lasting health or destroy stock. Here the poisoning is erased and the banked liquid is lost."},{"id":"e21","verdict":"accept","leaf":"prepared_day","reason":"The prepared forty finish routine work without new ambient injury and stock reconciles. The exposed expedition and wild competition still carry risk."},{"id":"e22","verdict":"reject","leaf":"cauldron_walk","reason":"Reload loses the grove bindings. This is the walk's red condition."},{"id":"c01","verdict":"reject","leaf":"persistent_metal","reason":"The poisoning clears on its own without advanced treatment. The owner forbids self-clearance, and the 'persistent' label does not change that."},{"id":"c02","verdict":"reject","leaf":"permanent_acid","reason":"The supposed permanent sensory injury leaves the original capacity intact. A label does not count as sensory harm."},{"id":"c03","verdict":"reject","leaf":"falter_warning","reason":"The visible vent and animal cues must give about one hour of warning. The optional message only supplements them and cannot replace a 500-tick cue."},{"id":"c04","verdict":"reject","leaf":"ambient_protection","reason":"Roof protection works for only one ambient route, since the roofed worker still takes acid burns. This is the red condition."},{"id":"c05","verdict":"reject","leaf":"connected_gas","reason":"The flame leaks through a sealed diagonal corner. The design requires both straight and diagonal sealed barriers to stop the chain."},{"id":"c06","verdict":"reject","leaf":"explosive_displacement","reason":"Goods are destroyed and respawned elsewhere with new ids. This is a listed false pass, not thrown identified goods."},{"id":"c07","verdict":"reject","leaf":"settings_control","reason":"All-off must not cure lasting health. The poisoning disappears and does not return after re-enable."},{"id":"c08","verdict":"reject","leaf":"thornwood_work","reason":"Metal must be growth-scaled. A young tree paying the same 12 steel as a full-grown one is not scaled, and the lower assay does not follow the payout."}],"ambiguities":["The permanent_acid leaf says acid 'can' leave permanent harm, and permanence is shown by a finite batch rather than a fixed rate. A single case that fully heals, as in e11, is read as the red condition, but it could alternatively be one non-permanent sample within a batch."]}
